contingency.description: The approved contingency that lets the return be filed.

documents.description: The documents of the period the requirement covers.

missing.description: What the gate waits for, in date order.

pending_contingency.description: The newest request for a contingency that nobody has approved yet: it lets nothing through until someone other than its requester approves it.

reason.description: Why the gate is not assessed.
examples: The InvoiceNow requirement is not marked as applying (setting invoicenow.applies).

state.description: not_assessed: the requirement is not marked as applying, or no sg-invoicenow version is active; ready: nothing is missing, or an approved contingency covers it; blocked: the return waits.
